findings.title: [P1] Keep branch names out of the shell command
findings.body: When `branch` contains shell syntax, `exec` parses it as part of the command rather than as one Git argument. For example, a value containing `; <command>` executes that command with the application's privileges; the previous `execFile("git", ["show", branch])` kept the value outside the shell. Preserve argument-based process execution (or otherwise avoid invoking a shell).
